title: P18.6 — Semantic-First Goal Understanding: versioned GoalIntentAnalysis (bounded 1-call interpretation, provenance classes), governed reconciliation + ambiguity/owner-approval policy, OFF/SHADOW/GUARDED modes, planner+replan integration, evidence persistence
description: P18.6 on base cabd25d (post-#155 main). Semantic-First Goal Understanding: new src/pair/semantic-goal-understanding.ts produces a versioned GoalIntentAnalysis via ONE bounded provider request per planning invocation (cached on goal x context x schema x model digest; malformed/unavailable => typed unavailable, never fabricated). Items carry id/source-span/category/provenance/confidence/authority-class (EXPLICIT_OPERATOR|VERIFIED_CONTEXT|MODEL_INFERRED|PROPOSED_AMENDMENT|OWNER_APPROVED|UNRESOLVED) - interpretation is ADVISORY only: extractGoalContract/assertPlanCoverage + P18.5 F10 ceilings + operatorGoalOf remain sole authority; advisory metadata never mints requirements, capabilities, budgets or permissions and never satisfies coverage. Deterministic reconcileIntent classifies contradictions; ambiguity policy HARMLESS|MATERIAL|AUTHORITY_CRITICAL fails closed only where warranted; owner-approved amendments mint a new canonical goal revision via authenticated approval bound to proposal+revision digests (append-only, stale previews invalidated). PAIR_SEMANTIC_MODE=off|shadow|guarded (default off; shadow persists+compares without changing validity; guarded informs planning and blocks materially-ambiguous confirms). Both planner transports get the bounded advisory block via buildPlannerUserPrompt; replan_generation pins the interpretation snapshot like planning_context. Scope-tenanted cache/evidence; no cross-tenant reuse; no secrets persisted. Semantic benchmark + adversarial tests prove zero authority violations; OFF mode is regression-identical to P18.5. No planner/canonicalizer/executor refactor; no auto-merge.
